description: This file defines the SaveEmploymentStatusController class, which manages the rendering logic for saving or editing employment status entities within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It extends a base controller, utilizes Vue components, and interacts with HTTP request attributes to determine the correct component to display.

classes.name: SaveEmploymentStatusController
classes.description: Controller handling the pre-render logic for employment status save/edit views based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component to be rendered, choosing between 'employment-status-edit' and 'employment-status-save' based on whether an 'id' attribute exists in the request.
